channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Euro: Downside risk persists toward 1.1550 against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann highlight that EUR/USD has shifted into short-term range trading between 1.1570 and 1.1610 after a dip to 1.1565 and rebound to 1.1608. They still see scope for a test of 1.1550 unless 1.1630 strong resistance breaks.

item.title: Gold sticks to gains amid weaker USD, soft bond yields; remains below $4,450
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) maintains its bid tone heading into the European session on Thursday, though it remains below $4,450 amid mixed fundamental cues.

item.title: GBP/USD Price Forecast: Holds a mildly bullish bias near 1.3500 despite subdued RSI momentum
item.description: The GBP/USD pair trades in positive territory around 1.3490 during the early European trading hours on Thursday, bolstered by a weaker US Dollar (USD). Traders await the Bank of England (BoE) Governor Andrew Bailey’s speech and US August jobs data later on Friday for fresh impetus.

item.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Turns sticky to 20-day EMA
item.description: The Euro (EUR) trades slightly higher against the US Dollar (USD) at around 1.1600 during the early European trading session on Thursday.

item.title: Indian Rupee hits fresh two-month high against US Dollar
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) opens strongly against the US Dollar (USD) on Thursday, extending the rally to near 94.28.

item.title: Indonesian Rupiah strengthens as US Dollar declines on potential Yen intervention
item.description: USD/IDR loses ground for the second successive day, trading around 17,730 during the Asian hours on Thursday. The currency pair experiences downward pressure as a sharp rally in the Japanese Yen (JPY) weighed heavily on the US Dollar (USD).

item.title: United States Dollar Index weakens below 99.50 as yields ease
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), an index of the value of the US Dollar (USD) measured against a basket of six world currencies, currently trades near 99.40 in the early European trading hours on Thursday. The DXY faces some selling pressure while US Treasury yields slipped from multi-year highs.

item.title: WTI Price Forecast: Consolidates above $89.00; bullish bias remains amid Iran risks
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) – the benchmark US Crude Oil price – struggles to capitalize on a modest Asian session uptick and currently trades just above the $89.00 mark, unchanged for the day.

item.title: India Gold price today: Gold rises, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices rose in India on Thursday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Falls to near 183.00 near symmetrical triangle bottom
item.description: EUR/JPY extends its losses for the second successive day, trading around 183.00 during the Asian hours on Thursday. Technical analysis of the daily chart indicates the currency cross remains within a symmetrical triangle, signalling a consolidation phase.

item.title: British Pound drops to three-week low as hawkish BoJ and suspected intervention boost Yen
item.description: The GBP/JPY cross remains under intense selling pressure for the second straight day and drops to a three-and-a-half-week low, around the 212.75-212.70 region during the Asian session on Thursday.

item.title: Canadian Dollar rises on weaker US Dollar, rising oil prices
item.description: USD/CAD extends its losses for the second consecutive day, trading around 1.3830 during the Asian hours on Thursday. The currency pair experiences downward pressure as a sharp rally in the Japanese Yen (JPY) weighed heavily on the US Dollar (USD).

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD extends gains as US Dollar falls further, NFP comes into focus
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) extends its Wednesday recovery move on Thursday, trading 0.67% higher at around $65.70 during the European trading session. The white metal strengthens as the US Dollar (USD) declines further due to moderate job demand in the United States (US) private sector.

item.title: Japanese Yen strengthens on BoJ rate hike signals
item.description: The USD/JPY pair attracts some sellers to near 158.15 during the Asian trading hours on Thursday. The Japanese Yen (JPY) strengthens against the US Dollar (USD) following hints from Japanese policymakers that interest rates will rise later this month.

item.title: Hegseth extends troop deployments in the Middle East through 2027 — WSJ
item.description: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth is extending troop deployment timelines across the Middle East, signaling the conflict could drag into 2027, the Wall Street Journal reported on Thursday.

item.title: Australian Dollar weakens against Japanese Yen following China’s Services PMI data
item.description: AUD/JPY extends its losses for the fourth consecutive day, trading around 113.50 during the Asian hours on Thursday. The Australian Dollar (AUD) remains subdued following a wave of mixed economic data from Australia and China, putting downward pressure on the currency cross.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar rebounds above 0.5850 on stronger Chinese services PMI
item.description: The NZD/USD pair recovers some lost ground to near 0.5860, snapping the four-day losing streak during the early Asian session on Thursday. The New Zealand Dollar (NZD) strengthens against the US Dollar (USD) following the upbeat Chinese economic data.

item.title: WTI holds gains above $89.50 amid renewed Middle East hostilities
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) oil price rebounds after registering losses in the previous day, trading around $89.60 during the Asian hours on Thursday. Crude oil prices advance as investors assessed renewed hostilities in the Middle East alongside efforts to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Australian Dollar flat lines above 0.7150 vs USD after Aussie trade data, China PMI
item.description: The AUD/USD pair struggles to capitalize on the previous day's bounce from the 0.7120 region, or a nearly two-week low, and oscillates in a range during the Asian session on Thursday.

item.title: China’s RatingDog Services PMI jumps to 51.4 in August, vs. 50.6 expected
item.description: China's Services Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) climbed to 51.4 in August from 50.4 in July, the latest data published by RatingDog showed on Thursday. This figure came in stronger than the market expectations of 50.6.

item.title: Australia’s Trade Balance shows a surplus of 1,923M MoM in July, vs. 1,390 expected
item.description: Australia's Trade Balance narrowed to A$1,923M MoM in July, followed a surplus of A$2,341M in the previous reading (revised from 1,929M), according to the latest foreign trade data published by the Australian Bureau of Statistics on Thursday. The market consensus was for a surplus of A$1,390M.

item.title: PBOC sets USD/CNY reference rate at 6.7807 vs. 6.7829 previous
item.description: The People’s Bank of China (PBOC) sets the USD/CNY central rate for the trading session ahead on Thursday at 6.7807 compared to the previous day's fix of 6.7829 and 6.7167 Reuters estimate.

item.title: British Pound consolidates near three-week low as Fed bets and Iran tensions support USD
item.description: The GBP/USD pair consolidates below the 1.3500 psychological mark during the Asian session on Thursday and remains close to a three-week low, touched the previous day.

item.title: Euro steadies below 1.1600 as hawkish Fed rhetoric limits gains
item.description: The EUR/USD pair holds steady near 1.1590 during the early Asian session on Thursday. The potential upside for the major pair might be limited amid hawkish Federal Reserve (Fed) expectations and escalating conflict in the Middle East.

item.title: US President Donald Trump: Renewed campaign against Iran will not continue for too long
item.description: US President Donald Trump said that while the US is prepared to strike Iran again at any time, he doesn’t expect the renewed fighting to last “too long,” Reuters reported on Wednesday.

item.title: The Australian Dollar's thirteen-year high is a New Zealand story
item.description: AUD/NZD spent Wednesday pushing at a ceiling that has held since 2013, running from near 1.2100 to a high short of 1.2300 and trading just above 1.2250 into the European afternoon.

item.title: Gold rebounds above $4,350 as US Dollar, Treasury yields slip
item.description: Gold price (XAU/USD) rebounds from a nearly one-month low to around $4,385 during the early Asian session on Thursday. The precious metal edges higher as the ‌US Dollar (USD) and Treasury yields retreat from recent highs.

item.title: GBP/JPY Price Forecast: Sellers eye 214.00 after SMA break
item.description: The Pound Sterling collapses versus the Japanese Yen as growing “speculation” of an intervention in the FX markets witnessed the Yen appreciating versus most G8 FX currencies. The GBP/JPY trades with losses of more than 1.10%, at 214.08.

item.title: The New Zealand Dollar sells the hike it asked for
item.description: The Reserve Bank of New Zealand (RBNZ) raised its policy rate on Wednesday and the currency fell almost 1.7% from top to bottom on the day it happened.

item.title: Australian Dollar rises as soft US jobs, GDP beat lift AUD, PMIs ahead
item.description: The Australian Dollar advanced on Wednesday versus the US Dollar after economic data in the US revealed the labour market weakened slightly, while the Greenback dipped on intervention speculation in the FX markets.
